name: Aziel
overview: Aziel was a male Levite known for his role as a harp-playing musician among the tribe of Levi. His unique attribute as a Levite skilled in harp playing highlights his participation in the worship practices of Israel. Scripture identifies him specifically in 1 Chronicles 15:20.
namesAndTitles: The name Aziel means 'G-d is my strength,' reflecting a declaration of reliance on God's power. This proper name is not indicated as given directly by God but carries significant spiritual meaning in its Hebrew origin.
familyAndRelationships: Aziel is explicitly identified as a descendant of Levi, situating him within the priestly tribe entrusted with temple duties. Beyond his tribal lineage, Scripture does not record additional family relationships for Aziel.
scriptureSignificance: Aziel's significance lies in his contribution to the Levitical musical ministry, specifically as a harp player during worship. His role underscores the importance of music in the service of God, particularly within the tribe of Levi, which was dedicated to temple service and worship leadership. Through his musical skill, Aziel participated in the spiritual life of Israel as recorded in 1 Chronicles.
